overhead 'Select Guild Chest'
@setvar! guildChest
overhead 'Select Distro Chest'
@setvar! distroChest
overhead 'Select Loot pouch'
@setvar! lootPouch

clearignore  
createlist regTypes
clearlist regTypes

@pushlist 'regTypes' '3891'
@pushlist 'regTypes' 'gold coin'
@pushlist 'regTypes' 'wall shelf'
@pushlist 'regTypes' 'toy'
@pushlist 'regTypes' '3827'
@pushlist 'regTypes' '24434'
@pushlist 'regTypes' 'bag of gems'
//@pushlist 'regTypes' 'phylactery'

foreach x in regTypes
    while findtype x lootPouch any any 1 as found
        lift found 9999
        drop guildChest -1 -1 0
        pause 600
    endwhile
    wait 200
endfor

clearignore 
createlist ItemTypes
clearlist ItemTypes

//extract
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '3836'
//core 
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '3985'
//MCD
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '24434' 
//skill orbs
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '22336'
//skill scrolls
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '8826'
//skill scrolls
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '17087'
//distills
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '17686'
// ship upgrades
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '5362'
// phylacs
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' 'phylactery'
// chroma distills
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '4026'
// chroma cores
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '4025'
// adv bag
@pushlist 'ItemTypes' '37181'

foreach x in ItemTypes
    while findtype x lootPouch any any 1 as found
        lift found 1
        drop distroChest 10 10 0
        pause 600
    endwhile
endfor

# move tmaps to distro
while findtype '5356' lootPouch 0 as item
    lift item 60000
    drop distroChest 10 10 0
    wait 600
endwhile

# move mining maps to guild
while findtype '5356' lootPouch 2796 as item
    lift item 60000
    drop guildChest 10 10 0
    wait 600
endwhile

# move skinning maps to guild
while findtype '5356' lootPouch 2651 as item
    lift item 60000
    drop guildChest 10 10 0
    wait 600
endwhile

# move lumber maps to guild
while findtype '5356' lootPouch 2799 as item
    lift item 60000
    drop guildChest 10 10 0
    wait 600
endwhile

# move fishing maps to guild
while findtype '5356' lootPouch 2904 as item
    lift item 60000
    drop guildChest 10 10 0
    wait 600
endwhile```
